name: dpoe_sig_crit
message: Built a 96x96, 10-frame, one-shot critical hit burst with no outline and no smoke or lingering glow: a white four-point star with a gold rim flashes on frame 2, eight thin white shards shoot outward, and a gold ring expands in frames 3-5 then breaks into pieces by frames 6-7. The effect is fully gone from frame 8 on, so the last three frames are blank on purpose, to match "gone by the last frame" (say if you'd rather I squeeze the motion into fewer frames). The shard speed, star size and ring size are the main things to tweak if you want it punchier.
